comments.subject: Public Comments
comments.comment: I'd like to see better bicycle connectivity. Later this month, I'll be spending time in St. George without my car. I was hoping to just use by bike to get around which works fine to get to downtown from Green Valley as there are excellent greenways all the way downtown from Green Valley. However, there is currently no safe bicycle route up to Snow Canyon High School, where the Snow Canyon half-marathon bus pickup is, from my place in Green Valley. It's a less than four mile ride but Dixie Dr. is just not safe for cyclists. If the GO bond fails, please find another way to create a safe bicycle route from Green Valley to Snow Canyon.

notes: Born-digital forwarded public comment submission. Contact info redacted.
